description: Read a native AVAX balance, a transaction receipt, or a contract view/pure function over RPC. No key needed. For contractRead pass the contract's ABI the same way write_contract takes it: as artifactPath (one of the `artifacts` scaffold_app returned) or as abi (the JSON ABI, or just the function's signature). To change state (for example to mint) use write_contract.

abi.description: For contractRead, instead of artifactPath: the JSON ABI, or signatures such as ["function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) view returns (address)"].

args.description: The function's arguments, in order. Pass large integers as decimal strings.

artifactPath.description: Path to the contract's artifact file, relative to the server's working directory: one of the `artifacts` scaffold_app returned (e.g. my-app/lib/nft-artifact.ts), or a Foundry/Hardhat JSON artifact with abi and bytecode. Must be inside the working directory.

functionName.description: For contractRead: the view or pure function to read, e.g. "ownerOf". To pick between overloads, the full signature, e.g. "balanceOf(address,uint256)".

name: read_chain
title: Read Avalanche chain data
